articles.title: At least ten killed in large-scale Russian missile and drone strikes on Kyiv
articles.description: Russia launched its biggest strikes on the city in weeks with children among the "significant number" of casualties, Ukrainian officials say.

articles.title: Aunt of Venezuelan boy pulled from rubble tells BBC she will give him 'mother's warmth'
articles.description: Kleiber Moran, 2, was rescued on Wednesday, six days after last week's deadly earthquakes.

articles.title: Controversial bishops ordained as Pope warns of 'schism' in Catholic Church
articles.description: Thousands of worshippers attended a ceremony in the Swiss Alps as part of the breakaway Society of Saint Pius X.

articles.title: Greek politician's mother dies of wounds after arson attack
articles.description: Three separate attacks involving petrol bombs and other improvised devices took place in Thessaloniki in the early hours of Wednesday.

articles.title: Five people injured after firebomb attacks targeting politicians in Greece
articles.description: Three pre-dawn firebomb attacks apparently targeting the residences of members of Greece's governing conservative New Democracy party have left five people in hospital, with one in a serious condition
